description.narrative: Number of policy briefs with advanced analysis using the NSCA produced by Tanzanian researchers and statisticians and discussed with policy makers

comment.narrative: Three policy briefs have been prepared using the NSCA. One on the spillover effect of large and medium scale farms to smallholders. A second is on the nexus between agriculture and tourism for high value crops in Zanzibar. And a third is on the adoption of irrigation and productivity among permanent crops smallscale farmers using banana production as a case study. The briefs are still in draft form and will be finalized and discussed with policy makers in August 2023.
